notesProvenance.scope: Concise Korean paraphrases of the producer's expression-specific Nose, Palate and Finish sections; description also uses the producer's introductory and Maturation text. Retailer tasting notes and personal reviews were not used.

sources.evidence: Title identifies The 1815 Legacy Edition. Maturation is first-fill bourbon followed by new European oak hogsheads. Current linked front image reads THE CASK LEGACY, 700ml and alc. 48% vol.
THE CASK LEGACY heading describes Laphroaig 1815 and its Read More link resolves to the 1815 Legacy Edition product page. This establishes the producer's own naming bridge.
Title combines both names as Laphroaig 1815 The Cask Legacy 48% 700ml; product description refers to The 1815. Cached product photograph visibly shows the current Cask Legacy bottle and box.
Laphroaig The 1815 Legacy Edition / 라프로익 1815 레거시 에디션; Information explicitly lists 48% and 700ml. Image shows the older green THE 1815 LEGACY EDITION presentation.

entries.identityDecision: One catalog expression with both names, supported by the producer's range-to-product link and the retailer's combined title. Dailyshot 5267 is an exact 1815 Legacy 48%/700ml mapping; its older packaging is disclosed rather than treated as a second whisky.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Single front bottle reads LAPHROAIG, CASK COLLECTION, THE CASK LEGACY, 700ml and alc. 48% vol. White cap marked established 1815; no age statement. The full-resolution PNG confirms the small volume/ABV text.

The exact Dailyshot listing depicts the older 1815 packaging. Do not claim that seller stock necessarily uses the current Cask Legacy packaging.

The producer establishes expression continuity, not a guarantee that every historical bottling has an identical recipe. Do not create a separate Cask Legacy price mapping without a separately verified listing.
